leastWorthwhile.text: The final gas action was less engaging as a decision because it was the only remaining combination, although its explanation was useful.

surprise.text: The disk material escaped early even though the rocky worlds continued colliding much later; that clarified the different timescales.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt purposeless: both corresponded directly to a stated goal, though the menu supplied their compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the connected astronomical story, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final one-option decision.
